name: Ikigai University
source:
The story follows Andee, a young and naive Akita who moves to Hibana Island after the school is recommended to him by his childhood best friend, Reo. A snow leopard with a love for tech, who definitely doesn't have a crush on Andee. (WHO WROTE THAT??)

During his time on Hibana, Andee slowly begins to find his place. With old friends back in his life and a strange new group forming around him, college starts to feel a little less overwhelming. Together, they stumble through relationships, personal problems, and plenty of stupid decisions as they try to figure out adulthood one mess at a time.

However, not everything is as it seems. Mysterious creatures are causing destruction across the island, and several of Andee’s new friends appear to be hiding things from him. Even Reo may know more about Hibana Island than he lets on. 

Something is deeply wrong with Hibana Island, and whether he likes it or not, Andee is already caught in the middle of it.

[From [url=https://malevolentgames.itch.io/ikigai-university]itch.io[/url]]
